api_scope.exclusion_scope: the observed invocation and its descendants
api_scope.missing_identity: emit api_root_identity_missing; do not claim scope_complete
api_scope.already_captured_excluded_invocation: reject input; do not silently erase historical evidence

traversal.python_function: definition, defaults, keyword defaults, closure references
traversal.ordinary_instance: builtin __dict__ and slot storage descriptors only
traversal.property_custom_getattribute_repr: never execute for observation; record boundary
traversal.observer_owned_state: retain references to exact registered observer objects; do not recursively enumerate instrumentation state or its growing evidence caches
traversal.cycles: visit identity once per snapshot; retain every observed alias edge
traversal.unboxed_native_members: retain declared native storage field as storage_member; do not manufacture Python scalar object identities from C values

object_observations.unobserved_ephemeral_values: outside snapshot contract; no synthetic object node
object_observations.missing_call_target_parent_or_return: invalid callchain evidence, independent of object snapshots
object_observations.storage: preserve each observed object identity and reference delta; no importance classifier
object_observations.native_argument_and_return_values: not available from CPython profile events in the current collector
object_observations.reuse: full observed-reference signatures and current-snapshot first-visit state; type/source context validated; mutations invalidate; no object or edge discarded by importance
object_observations.reference_storage: legacy per-view deltas or explicitly declared shared-adjacency-states/1; define each exact parent adjacency once and preserve each call view update by state id; validate every object, state and removal

edges.python_parent: must equal active stack top on the same thread
edges.native_parent: same-thread matched enter/exit stack; same Python window => instrumented_nesting
edges.python_to_native: validated same-thread, same-pid, time-contained window => window_contains
edges.direct_machine_call: never infer from nesting; requires separate transfer evidence

native_window_policy: Python and C boundary owners are allowed; Python owners require an explicit python-and-c-boundaries/1 collector receipt, with unchanged thread, timestamp and matched native stack checks
source_mapping: annotation only; cannot add, remove or reparent invocations
replay: canonical JSON, stable IDs from input sequence, no clock/randomness/network/LLM
limits: balanced omissions cannot be detected from nesting alone; collector sequence and loss receipts are required
old evidence without API identity or exclusion policy stays scope_incomplete
replayer validates emitted observations; it does not prove every runtime event was observed
